name: notification-popover
title: Notification popover
description: The bell in a header: a count badge, a panel of the latest notifications with unread marked in words, mark all as read, and a link to the full list.
docs: Pass items (id, title, body, time, href, unread, actor or icon), the unreadCount if the server knows more than the list holds, and the callbacks: onOpenItem receives the event so a client-side router can call preventDefault, onMarkRead(id) runs for an unread row that was opened, onMarkAllRead shows the button. The badge caps at 99+ and the bell is named "Notifications, 3 unread"; the panel announces "3 unread notifications" when it opens from a live region on the bell. Rows are links (or buttons without an href) with one tab stop and arrow keys, Home and End between them. Pass now so the times, like "4 min. ago", are the same in server HTML and in the browser; without it they start as dates. NotificationPanel is the inside on its own, for a sheet on a phone. max is the most rows drawn, loading draws skeleton rows, and labels translate every word.
